name: Mrs. Ramirez's Pre-Ride Check
description: Learn A-B-C-Quick with Mrs. Ramirez, repair her slow rear-tube leak, and finish a solo final inspection.

steps.description: Talk with Mrs. Ramirez by her bike and learn A-B-C-Quick.
Write A-B-C-Quick in the notebook.
A - Air: check the front tire.
A - Air: discover the slow leak in the rear tire.
B - Brakes: hold the front brake until the pads bite.
B - Brakes: hold the rear brake until it catches firm.
C - Chain: spin the pedal and watch the chain run clean.
Quick check: wheel spins true.
Quick check: seat is firm.
Quick check: handlebars line up with the front wheel.
Take Mrs. Ramirez's flat rear tube to the garage.
Meet Mr. Chen at the garage tire station.
Ease the tube out for repair.
Find the slow leak by listening and looking for bubbles.
Mark the leak on the notebook tube diagram.
Sand, cement, and patch the marked leak.
Let the patch cement set before adding pressure.
Re-inflate the tube until it firms up.
Test the tube again: no bubbles.
Bring the repaired tube back to Mrs. Ramirez.
Final inspection: check Air yourself.
Final inspection: check Brakes yourself.
Final inspection: check Chain yourself.
Final inspection: finish the Quick check yourself.
Mrs. Ramirez confirms the bike is ready to ride.

success_dialogue: Perfect. You did that yourself. That's a real pre-ride check, Zuzu. You can do this for any bike, anywhere. Thank you.
reward_text: You learned A-B-C-Quick and got Mrs. Ramirez's bike ready to ride.
